name: cardz-marketcap
description: CARDZ collectible-card and TCG market data: exact-printing search, verified vs reference prices, 2025+ OHLCV candles, Top 500 market depth, rankings, and portfolio valuation.

interface.longDescription: CARDZ provides public collectible-card and trading-card market data across Pokémon, One Piece, and expanding collectible IPs. Search exact printings, inspect dated USD prices and 2025+ OHLCV candles, explore Top 500 cross-region market depth, view published rankings, or evaluate a multi-card portfolio with explicit disambiguation. Read-only service with no player account or payment access. Operated by Jackz Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd., Japan.
